Episode 251. The Great Adversaries (1)
June 2, 1804, midnight.
As the battle between the Abyss Legion, Bligiet, and Kelliark was in full swing atop the Tower of Tales, the Barmul Alliance was witnessing the unexpected opening of an iron door in the garden.
"An iron door? Has Orgal gone mad, opening that in the middle of Tikan Palace without permission?"
"Eh, Murakan friend. Are some dark things spilling out of that door?"

"Exactly, what is that? An invasion, really? After they sent a letter to Brother Jin and declared surrender, they backstab us like this? But how could they even think of attacking here? With three Genesis and countless superhuman forces. It's madness."
Black silhouettes, almost human-like, were already pouring out by the dozens. Just as Kasimir was about to declare an emergency, Orgal appeared last from the iron door.
Orgal, even from a distance, was visibly grimacing. He seemed very uncomfortable, but showed no sign of starting an attack. The black silhouettes stood silently beside him.
The superhumans of the Alliance immediately surrounded them.
"Orgal, what is this madness? What are these black lumps?"
Murakan stepped forward in front of Orgal, followed by Luna and Runtia. And before Orgal could answer, they realized the identity of the 'black lumps'.
"Wait a minute... that... is that me? My god, is it really me?"
"...What? Sister, you felt it too?"
"Huh? What are you two talking about? What's going on?"
Luna and Runtia were shivering with a strange sensation they had never experienced before, facing another 'self'.

The Abyss Legion was not composed solely of Orgals. It included a few other heroes who had come to Helluram from various worlds due to a mix of coincidences and fate. Other world versions of Luna and Runtia were among them.
'It just looks like a monster, or a black lump of flesh, but that's definitely me. Worn down by endless struggles and battles, devolved into...'
'How can this be? How...?'
The other companions also sensed something strange.
[Ha-ha! I was worried there wouldn't be a match for these soldiers, but fortunately, there is. Of course, there had to be. This will speed up the explanation! Damn it! Great, great! Ah, wonderful!]

As soon as Orgal spoke, the members of Tikan were struck dumb. Something had happened, and it seemed like he had lost his mind. Luna and Runtia were sweating in shock, leaving their comrades confused.
"...Orgal. Marjiella mentioned in her letter that you wanted to talk, but I didn't expect this. You seem to have changed a bit since I last saw you. Are you alright?"
[Yeah, sure. My dear Jin Runkandel! I'm fine, really, I am... sob, sob.]
Suddenly, Orgal burst into tears, and Jin handed him a handkerchief without realizing.
[Get lost! How dare you try to console my grief? You who just appeared now?]
"Has he really gone crazy? Hey, do you want to die?"
[Ha-ha, yes, yes. You still know nothing, do you, Murakan, my old friend. But ignorance is a big sin.]
"Ugh, my head. I can't take this. Kid, ask why this is happening. Luna, Runtia. Get yourselves together and explain."
"Orgal, calm down. Let's talk about what's happening. Sisters, please explain."
Pang, pa-heheng! (Idk how to tl this lol) Under the moonlight, Orgal blew his nose and wiped his face for a while. Luna and Runtia composed themselves and spoke first.
"Jin, it's hard to explain, but among those black lumps, two of those are me and Runtia. I recognized them immediately. Somewhere... from another world, it's me."
"Another world, you say?"
"Yes. Definitely me, but lived a different life. Suddenly, I felt the memories of this black lump."
It was unlikely that Luna was making this up. Even if Orgal was casting some spell, the insight of Genesis wouldn't collapse so easily.
Jin recalled the letter sent by Marjiella.
-(Actually, we've had a confusing incident recently. After the leader met the witch, a lot has changed... It's better to hear it directly from the leader later. It's quite shocking.)
Soon, Beradin, Sandra, and Hedo, who arrived late, reacted the same way upon seeing the Abyss Legion.
"I was... an ally of Orgal?"
"I haven't met the real Jin yet? Besides, how can I be two?"
"What's happening."
Memories from another world continued to flood in. They did not receive as clear memories as Orgal, but they were certain that the soldier was 'themselves'.
[Jin Runkandel.]
Orgal spoke again, his face now normal and his eyes deep and firm as usual.
[I'll tell you the truth of this world. A story I heard directly from Helluram. Call Valeria Hister. She must know this too.]
"Let's go inside."
All the main members of the Alliance in Tikan, waiting for Orgal, gathered in the conference room.
Afterward, Orgal detailed everything he had heard from Helluram to Jin and the Barmel Alliance.
Throughout his narrative, he often took breaks, seemingly in pain. Sighs mixed with anger, frustration, sorrow, regret, despair, and hatred seeped out like poison between his teeth.
Some superhumans who had seen the memories of the soldiers were particularly struggling to calm their confused minds.

[...That's all. Do you understand now? Why our Kinzelo decided to help you, why I seem mad. Ah, of course, you'll say you need evidence. The memories of those who saw another version of themselves from the Abyss Legion will be evidence, and... damn, do I have to worry about that kind of thing too?]
A long silence followed after the story ended.
It wasn't because they thought he was lying. The truth was just too immense to accept easily.
Even Ameris and Eltiot, who had lived since ancient times, couldn't fully grasp Orgal's story. The only ones who 'felt' it were those who had seen themselves in the Abyss Legion.

[Isn't it interesting, Jin Runkandel? The fact that you and Valeria Hister have never appeared in any other world. That makes you two the only variables unknown to the beings of other dimensions among us...]
Everyone in the conference room was paying attention to that fact.
Even according to the memories Orgal had from the Abyss Legion, it wasn't the first time Laprarosa was liberated.
So far, it had been liberated twice in other worlds. Once by Temar, and another time by Orgal, Cold Jo, and Siron.
However, there was never a case where the Plutonian was fully released like now.
[In the worlds experienced by other Orgals, half of the warriors either died or were freed in a state no better than corpses. And that technology of Laprarosa was used for the Ziffle instead.]

There were other occurrences too, like Gliac being unsealed, the birth of the evil gods, Zito awakening, and the appearance of the Red Plutonian. From the perspective of the Abyss Legion, these were events repeated several times in history.
Even without Jin, all these events happened somewhere, with only minor differences in details. And at the end, it was always the victory of Ziffle.
[Why, why of all people... Jin Runkandel, why you?]
Orgal looked into Jin's eyes.
He had a frustrated expression. He was the one who had fought in those many worlds, who had become the Abyss Legion even after death to stand here again.
He found it hard to accept why Jin now seemed more special than himself.
On the other hand, he felt somewhat relieved.
In no world had Orgal ever had such a powerful ally as the current Barmel Alliance. If he fully joined hands with the Barmel Alliance, he thought he might finally defeat Ziffle.

[No, now that I think about it, why isn't important. Whether Solderet really read all this and prepared you and Valeria Hister for it, or if he is being used by the Master of the Magic Tower, that's what's important.]
"So, you mean I can't fully trust you, Orgal, since Solderet's true intentions haven't been completely revealed."
[Exactly.]

"It's mutual. All the content you shared today is probably true. However, those Orgals from other worlds, strictly speaking, are not you. You are a different person with a different life and purpose. Just because those Orgals protected the world to the end doesn't mean you will."
The true alliance between the Barmel Alliance and Kinzelo was a cautious and difficult issue. Until recently, Kinzelo's goal wasn't the downfall of Ziffle, but the resurrection of the Sun God.

[Even if you decide not to fight Ziffle and try to persuade me, my life is already determined. Regardless of the Sun God's resurrection, those beings must be destroyed. Damn, until recently I was an enemy of most of your comrades, and now I feel something akin to camaraderie with them. Different person? They were definitely me. And even people like Luna were my comrades!]
Orgal thought of the dire ends of other worlds, his comrades who had stayed with him until the end, and those now standing before him in different forms.

[Anyway, whether you trust me or not doesn't matter. You've always fought against Ziffle, so it's unlikely you'll suddenly join them. Of course, I have to always consider the possibility of Solderet's betrayal. Don't take it too badly, it's unavoidable from my perspective.]
The true intention of Solderet.
Jin instinctively guessed it was related to the space of the Black Sea that Siron mentioned. And Orgal already knew that information.
As the two of them sorted out their thoughts, Valeria spoke for the first time.
"Orgal, you said that Jin and I never appeared in any other world."
[Yes.]
"But I think, even if Jin didn't, I must have been
active in those worlds... Otherwise, there would have been no reason for me to see this record window when Lapralosa was liberated."
-<Your Jin Runkandel succeeded.>
The blue record window that appeared over the staff on the day Lapralosa was liberated.
Valeria displayed the record window again to Orgal.
"This might be a record left by me from another world to myself in this world."
